candidates.source_name: MNB — Határozatok és végzések keresése (supervisory decisions & orders search)
candidates.why_relevant: Central searchable database of all MNB supervisory decisions, filterable by period, sector (pénzpiac, biztosítási piac, tőkepiac, pénztár) and type (engedélyezés / jogérvényesítés / piacfelügyelet / fogyasztóvédelem). Engedélyezési (licensing) decisions include the statutory prior approval of 'vezető állású személy' appointments at banks, payment institutions and financial enterprises — i.e. named executive appointments with dates and institution, the legally-forced spine of A5.
candidates.access_status: public, free; search UI (dynamic application), decisions published as PDF
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector information published under MNB statutory disclosure policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scripted query of the decision search filtered to pénzpiac + engedélyezés; harvest decision numbers (H-EN-I-xxx/YYYY pattern) and PDF links; parse institution name, person name, role, effective date. Handle dynamic app / possible ASP.NET postback pagination.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search on seed query + snowball from MNB archive pages

Essential decoding key that lets a collector filter for exactly the licensing decisions covering executive appointments and to construct/recognise decision IDs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch; encode the mapping as a lookup table in the parser; re-check annually.

candidates.source_name: MNB — Személyi engedélyek / vezető állású személy engedélyezése (licensing subject pages)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines WHICH roles at which institution types require MNB prior approval (hitelintézet, pénzügyi vállalkozás, pénzforgalmi intézmény, befektetési alapkezelő, biztosító) and the procedural timeline. Sets the scope and expected latency of the whole legally-forced A5 spine, and lists per-sector sub-pages that are themselves crawl targets.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Static fetch of the sector sub-pages; used as scoping/context, not for event extraction.

candidates.why_relevant: The 'jó üzleti hírnév' / fit-and-proper data-sheet forms reveal exactly which attributes about an executive are captured by the regulator (roles, prior mandates, qualifying holdings) — useful for designing the person-entity schema and for knowing what is legally on file even when not published.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off download for schema design; not a recurring feed.
queries_used: MNB piaci szereplők keresése intézménykereső vezető állású személyek nyilvántartás

candidates.source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (market participant / institution register)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative list of every MNB-licensed or registered bank, financial enterprise, payment institution, e-money issuer, investment firm and fund manager in Hungary, plus cross-border passporting entities. This is the master ACTOR MAP for A5 — the universe of employers whose officer changes must then be tracked. Institution-level only; per my fetch it does not itself list executives.
candidates.access_status: public, free; dynamic search UI, no obvious bulk export observed
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector register (Mnbtv. 2013. évi CXXXIX. tv.)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate by sector/category dropdown, scrape result tables into an entity master list keyed on MNB registration number + cégjegyzékszám; refresh monthly to catch new/deregistered institutions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search + snowball from MNB piaci szereplők page

candidates.source_name: MNB Közzétételek (OAM) — officially appointed mechanism for regulated information
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory central storage mechanism where issuers and regulated entities file 'szabályozott információ' under Tpt./Bszt./Kbftv. Duplicates and sometimes exceeds BÉT coverage (includes non-BÉT-listed bond issuers such as bank subsidiaries), and gives stable downloadable document IDs. Strong cross-check for BÉT and a POINTER to issuers never covered by the press.
candidates.access_status: public, free; query interface plus direct document download endpoint (downloadkozzetetel?id=..&did=..)
candidates.legal_status: statutory disclosure repository operated by MNB; public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the lekérdező/search endpoint filtered by issuer set (banks, payment institutions) and title keywords; fetch documents via the downloadkozzetetel pattern; store did= as the stable key.
queries_used: kozzetetelek.mnb.hu szabályozott információk kibocsátói közzététel

candidates.source_name: e-cégjegyzék (official electronic company register, Ministry of Justice)
candidates.why_relevant: Every Zrt./Kft. officer change (vezető tisztségviselő, cégjegyzésre jogosult, felügyelőbizottsági tag) must be registered within 30 days; the cégkivonat lists current and (in the paid stored extract) deleted officers with effective dates. This is the ground truth for A5 leadership-change events at every Hungarian bank, payment institution, fintech and their subsidiaries — including entities with no press coverage at all.
candidates.access_status: free basic 'ingyenes cégadatok' query (updated weekly, typically Mondays); full/authenticated cégkivonat and historical officer data are paid; free service reportedly requires accepting personal-data handling
candidates.legal_status: public register under 2006. évi V. tv. (Ctv.); reuse of paid extracts may be licence-limited — check terms before redistribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyed lookup by cégjegyzékszám from the MNB Intézménykereső entity list; weekly diff of the officer block per entity to emit change events. Respect rate limits and the paid-tier terms; consider the OCCSZ paid channel for historical/deleted officers.
queries_used: e-cégjegyzék cégkivonat cégjegyzésre jogosult változás lekérdezés

candidates.legal_status: official; paid licence — redistribution restricted, check ÁSZF

negative_findings.description: The MNB Intézménykereső (intezmenykereso.mnb.hu) was fetched and, on the content returned, exposes institution-level registration data only — it does not publish a browsable register of 'vezető állású személyek' per institution, and no bulk export/download mechanism was apparent.
negative_findings.result_summary: No regulator-maintained, queryable person-level officeholder register found for HU banking. Executive names must be reconstructed from individual decision PDFs, BÉT/OAM filings, and the cégjegyzék.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out the cheapest possible collection design and forces a document-parsing + register-diffing pipeline; also means person-level coverage will always be assembled, never authoritative from one source.

negative_findings.description: The legacy MNB decision-search application host alk.mnb.hu (referenced by an indexed URL alk.mnb.hu/bal_menu/hatarozatok/hatarozatok_keresese) failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND) from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a HYPOTHESIS of a retired/renamed host, not a verdict — the current live entry point appears to be www.mnb.hu/felugyelet/engedelyezes-es-intezmenyfelugyeles/hatarozatok-es-vegzesek-keresese. Liveness to be settled by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Old indexed URLs for the MNB decision database are still circulating; a collector hard-coded to alk.mnb.hu would silently collect nothing.

negative_findings.description: A guessed MNB path https://www.mnb.hu/felugyelet/engedelyezes-es-intezmenyfelugyeles/hatarozatok-vegzesek returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: The correct slug is '/hatarozatok-es-vegzesek-keresese'. Recorded as a moved/incorrect path, not a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents the exact correct slug so downstream collectors do not repeat the guess.

negative_findings.description: The BÉT issuer-news page (bet.hu/kib_hirek) was fetched; the returned content showed a search box and chronological listing but no RSS feed, category filter for governance/management changes, or export endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection from BÉT will require HTML scraping of the listing plus title keyword filtering and PDF text extraction; no clean API observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering cost and fragility expectations for what is otherwise the highest-signal A5 source for listed financial issuers.

negative_findings.description: Historical/deleted officer data (törölt tisztségviselők, with from/to dates) is not available in the free e-cégjegyzék tier; it requires the paid OCCSZ channel or a commercial aggregator (OPTEN, Céginfo). Free e-cégjegyzék data is also refreshed only weekly and reportedly conditions free access on personal-data handling consent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tenure reconstruction for HU bank executives has a hard cost and licensing component; no free authoritative historical officer feed was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and legal review are prerequisites before A5 can produce career-history or churn analytics rather than event spotting.

negative_findings.description: I found no Hungarian-language term for a consolidated, cross-institution 'senior management appointments register' in banking — the concept appears not to exist as a named product; the terminology space is fragmented across 'személyi engedély', 'vezető állású személy engedélyezése', 'cégjegyzésre jogosult', 'vezető tisztségviselő'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary is fragmented by legal regime (Hpt./Mnbtv. vs Ctv. vs Tpt.), each using a different word for overlapping populations of people.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity/role normalisation across the three legal regimes is a mandatory modelling step; naive keyword matching will under- or over-count leadership events.

negative_findings.description: English-language searches for HU fit-and-proper decisions returned mostly law-firm guides (Legal 500, Healy Consultants) and the MNB EN mirror — no English feed of actual named appointment decisions.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection for this cell would capture essentially zero primary events; Hungarian-language collection is mandatory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the run's local-language mandate empirically and warns against staffing this cell with EN-only tooling.

coverage_gaps.description: I could not exercise the actual query mechanics of the three core event sources (MNB határozatok és végzések keresése, cegkozlony.hu/kereses, kozzetetelek.mnb.hu lekérdező) — parameter names, pagination, date filtering, rate limits and anti-bot behaviour are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a hands-on technical probe (browser automation + network capture) against each of the three search endpoints to capture request payloads and build stable collectors; document per-endpoint rate limits.

coverage_gaps.description: No crosswalk was found between MNB institution identifiers (Intézménykereső registration numbers) and cégjegyzékszám / adószám, which is required to join regulator decisions to company-register officer events.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the crosswalk manually for the ~100-entity HU banking/payments watchlist from Intézménykereső records plus e-cégjegyzék lookups; store as the canonical entity table for all A5 cells.

coverage_gaps.description: Savings cooperatives, small pénzügyi vállalkozások, PSD2 payment/e-money institutions and independent intermediaries are inside the statutory regime but were not individually enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full Intézménykereső population per sector category and the Közvetítők keresése register, then apply the same Cégközlöny/e-cégjegyzék officer-diff pipeline uniformly.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level registers that mirror or supplement HU officeholder/entity data (EBA credit institutions register, ESMA registers, SSM/ECB fit-and-proper for significant institutions such as OTP) were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up probe of EBA/ESMA/ECB registers for HU-domiciled institutions; ECB fit-and-proper applies to significant institutions and may publish or imply senior-appointment approvals not visible on mnb.hu.

coverage_gaps.description: The publication lag between an actual appointment, the MNB decision, the Cégközlöny entry and the e-cégjegyzék refresh has not been measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backtest 10-20 known 2024-2026 HU bank executive changes across all four sources and measure per-source latency, to decide which source is the trigger and which are the confirmations.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell's regulatory/statutory sources cover officeholders well but carry almost no signal on the 'jobs / hiring' topic (vacancy volumes, headcount trends) beyond annual headcount in e-beszámoló filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on other A5 cells (job boards, career sites, KSH labour statistics) for hiring volume; use e-beszámoló 'átlagos statisztikai létszám' from this cell as the annual authoritative anchor for validating them.

coverage_gaps.description: Reuse and redistribution rights differ sharply across sources: MNB/Cégközlöny/e-beszámoló are free public-sector information, while OCCSZ extracts and OPTEN/Céginfo data are licensed products, and all officer data is personal data under GDPR.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain a written legal position on (a) storing named-person officer histories for internal market intelligence and (b) the redistribution terms of each paid register product, before operationalising the pipeline.

brief: Hungary has an unusually strong legally-forced spine for A5 officeholder intelligence, but it is split across three separate legal regimes rather than one register: MNB prior approval of 'vezető állású személyek' (published as numbered H-EN-I-style decisions via the Határozatok és végzések keresése database), Tpt. §55 issuer disclosures filed to BÉT's Kibocsátói hírek and to the MNB's OAM at kozzetetelek.mnb.hu (where 'Közlemény vezető állású személyek körében bekövetkező változásról' is a standard document type), and Ctv.-mandated company-register entries surfacing in the Cégközlöny and e-cégjegyzék within 30 days of any officer change. Crucially, no regulator-side person-level officeholder register appears to exist — the MNB Intézménykereső is institution-level only — so person-level coverage must be assembled by diffing register officer blocks and parsing decision/disclosure PDFs, with historical (deleted-officer) data behind the paid OCCSZ channel or commercial aggregators such as OPTEN. The cell's pointer value is high: Intézménykereső plus the Közvetítők register define an entity universe of banks, financial enterprises, payment/e-money institutions and intermediaries that press-driven cells never enumerate, and per-bank 'felügyeleti határozatok' pages (e.g. MBH Bank) plus Magyar Közlöny appointments for state banks (MFB, EXIM, MEHIB) close the remaining segments. Local-language collection is mandatory — English searching surfaced only law-firm summaries and the thin MNB EN mirror, and zero primary named-appointment events.
